summary.name: GitaGPT
summary.one_liner: GitaGPT is an AI spiritual guide that answers personal life questions with verses from the Bhagavad Gita, voiced by Lord Krishna or one of nine other Vedic guides.
use_cases: Getting Bhagavad Gita verses matched to a personal problem
Seeking spiritual advice on grief, relationships or career
Asking questions in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu or Bengali
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a chat interface where users type or speak questions about relationships, grief, career, anxiety or purpose and receive answers that cite a specific Bhagavad Gita shloka. Users can choose from 10 guides, including Krishna, Shiva and Hanuman, each answering from their own Vedic perspective. It states support for over 20 languages, including Hindi, Tamil, Telugu and Bengali. Tiered plans add features such as a daily shloka, guided meditations, and in the top tier, live sessions with human gurus. The page also claims 35M+ answers generated, though this is a marketing figure.
notable: Answers cite exact Bhagavad Gita shlokas and claims to be grounded in Vedic scripture
10 selectable guides including Krishna, Shiva and Hanuman
Supports 20+ Indian and other languages, not just translation
Top tier includes 2 live one-on-one human guru sessions per month
caveats: Free Seeker tier is limited to 5 conversations per day
Voice AI, unlimited chats, and ad-free use require the paid Devotee tier
Family plan and human guru sessions require the top Sadhak tier; prices are not stated on the page
